about_the_game:
"You must be the new guy... Right?"

SYNOPSIS

Since that tragedy... things have become difficult. Your family needs the money, and... it doesn't seem like a complicated job. Just answer the phone and help the customers. Piece of cake!

Plus, you're still young, and if you don't like it, you can always quit and try something else in the future... right?

ANOTHER DAY AT THE OFFICE

The "Day at the Office - Signed" DLC expands the "Day at the Office" experience by putting us in the shoes of a new employee, offering a more extensive and deeper narrative. Key features of this DLC include:

  • Increased Duration: The story significantly extends alongside the main game, allowing for a deeper immersion into the universe.

  • Variety of Situations: Players will face a wider range of events and challenges, enriching the gameplay and keeping the story engaging throughout.

  • Crucial Decisions: As in the prologue, the choices you make will remain pivotal, directly influencing the development and outcome of the story.

  • New Locations: In addition to the office, the narrative expands to the protagonist’s home, providing a new setting that will also be affected by the story and your decisions...

HIRED!

"Will you be able to leave work at the office...?"

The new chapter, "Day at the Office - Signed," will offer a more complex and immersive adventure, exploring both the protagonist's work environment and personal life.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not suitable for all ages or to be viewed at work: Frequent violence or gore, self-harm, General mature content.
